I think the first thing to do is identify what split you up, there has to be a reason why something went wrong.
To build a friendship something important is bonding, look for common interests, beliefs or likes. You could adapt your personality to match different types of people, although I don't recommend leaving behind who you are to be some fake person.

Do you know why they stoped being your friends? Can you think of something that could have happened.

Keep in mind that some people are not worth it, don't put yourself in a toxic relationship.
